messages:
sofia_sourcing: FYI vendor (GlobeTech) just sent final QA report for batch #G-1092. 48 units allocated to EU pool. Inspection flagged firmware mismatch on 12 units and 2 units with minor cosmetic dent. Vendor asking: accept as-is with credit or reflash/replace. AWB options: consolidated sea (cheaper) vs split air for affected units. ETA if replace: +12 business days.

adele_infra: can you paste the serials and model SKUs? need to check Dedicated reservations and canary routing.

sofia_sourcing: serials pasted below (from vendor CSV):
```
GT-H100-00123
GT-H100-00124
GT-H100-00125
GT-H100-00126
GT-H100-00127
GT-H100-00128
GT-H100-00129
GT-H100-00130
GT-H100-00131
GT-H100-00132
GT-H100-00133
GT-H100-00134
```
models: H100-48GB-A (48 units), affected: first 12 serials above. Vendor note: mismatch in bootloader version (v1.2.0 shipped vs expected v1.3.1), kernel-level check failing on our smoke run.

kevin_logistics: customs note: if we split air for 12 units, broker fees + duties estimate ~ €5k, consolidation sea saves ~€3k but adds ~10 days. Any regulatory holds? EU DUTY code unchanged.

mike_ops: That +12 business days is painful for capacity commitments. What's impact to Dedicated customers if we short those 12? (esp. batch pinned for eu-dedicated-2). We may need to deploy loaners.

julia_sre: If bootloader mismatch only, vendor can probably reflash in the depot. Ask if they will reflash pre-shipment and provide checksum. We should insist on reflash + replayable sig for provenance. Quarantine effected units on arrival and route them to EU-staging for validation tests (smoke + kvcache test).

sofia_sourcing: opened a question to vendor: will they reflash on their end or offer runway credit? They offered 7% per-unit credit by default. I pushed back asking for full reflash + test matrix, or 8 business day air replacement. Waiting on response.

rma_bot: New RMA ticket created #RMA-2026-482: vendor-reflash-request. Linked AWB: TBD. Assigned: kevin_logistics.

kevin_logistics: I can coordinate AWB consolidation if vendor ships replacements via air. But we need vendor to prepay broker on consolidated AWB to avoid hold. Also recommend partial consolidation: ship 36 units sea as planned, air 12 replacements. That keeps provisioning moving.

adele_infra: Reserve status: redwood-reserve-queue has 10 loaner H100s in FRA staging, can cover most of shortfall for next 72h if we accept loaners. After that customers on Dedicated will see throttled capacity. Recommend we authorize transfer of 10 loaners to eu-dedicated-2 immediately.

mike_ops: Approve moving 10 loaners from reserve to eu-dedicated-2 as temporary. Finance: we should capture vendor credit negotiation to offset loaner ops cost. Sofia, ask vendor to cover expedited freight + reflash labour or give 12% credit.

sofia_sourcing: vendor responded: they will reflash 8/12 of affected units onsite and will send 4 replacements by air in 6 business days. They will offer 9% credit on reworked units. They refuse to prepay broker fees for air.

julia_sre: Not ideal. Reflash onsite reduces shipping but still need validation. We require vendor to deliver reflash report + checksum for each reworked serial. Also we want SLA amendment: 48h hold for failed post-reflash.

kevin_logistics: If vendor won't prepay broker, we can pay and invoice them, but that delays customs release. Carrier will hold until charges cleared. Estimate immediate cash out ~ €4.2k.

mike_ops: Do it—pay to get replacements moving. We can invoice vendor and hold 9% credit until we validate. Ops cost for loaner movement ~ €1.1k; capture it as chargeback.

sofia_sourcing: action list: 1) confirm loaner transfer (adele) 2) approve carrier prepay (kevin) 3) vendor to provide reflash reports + checksums (sofia) 4) rma_bot to track replacements (rma_bot).

adele_infra: starting transfer of 10 loaners to eu-dedicated-2 now. ETA in-cluster ~ 18h. I'll update routing and canary so we don't hit production pools unexpectedly. :white_check_mark:

kevin_logistics: I've approved carrier prepay. I'll email finance for immediate wire and capture invoice to pass to vendor. AWB provisional: AWB-GLT-531209. Will share tracking once carrier confirms pickup.

rma_bot: RMA-2026-482 updated: vendor reflash plan accepted partially, replacements 4 units by air. Linked AWB AWB-GLT-531209. Status: in-transit.

mike_ops: Good. Two additional asks: 1) Document acceptance criteria for reworked units and add to ticket. 2) If more than 5% of batch fails post-reflash, escalate to procurement for full replacement.

sofia_sourcing: added acceptance criteria to ticket: smoke pass, kvcache flush test, bootloader checksum match (v1.3.1), no ECC errors after 24h burn-in. Also asked vendor for test logs attached to shipment.

julia_sre: On arrival we'll run the canary plan: 2 units into canary, 6h latency/regression run, then progressive rollout to remaining hosts. Keep rollback policy ready.

kevin_logistics: pickup scheduled this afternoon. Carrier ETA to FRA hub 48h. I set customs broker to expedite release once funds clear.

sofia_sourcing: vendor also asked if Redwood will accept a consolidated invoice with credit applied or prefer separate credit note. Finance prefers consolidated + PO ref. I'll send PO refs.

mike_ops: keep an eye on eu-dedicated-2 SLOs. Adele, once loaners arrive coordinate a brief maintenance window for the migration.

adele_infra: noted. I'll schedule rolling migration hours 02:00-06:00 CET and notify customers.

sofia_sourcing: vendor confirmed reflash reports will be attached to AWB manifest and uploaded to RMA ticket. They accepted to reimburse broker within net 30 after we submit carrier receipts.

mike_ops: ok. Closing loop: we used 10 loaners, approved €4.2k prepay, vendor credit 9% on reworked units + reimburse broker net30. rma_bot, keep this thread updated and close RMA when validation complete.

rma_bot: RMA-2026-482 will auto-close on validation success. I'll post updates: pickup, customs release, arrival, validation start, validation pass/fail.

sofia_sourcing: thanks everyone. tagging summary: @adele_infra (move loaners), @kevin_logistics (prepay + AWB), @mike_ops (SLA carveouts), @julia_sre (validation plan). Will follow up in ticket. :v:
